description: Asynchronous messaging between two modules departs from the ADR that fixes their synchronous integration: the impact declaration plus the adr-amend-or-contradict gate.

input.request: Publish an order-placed event so billing reacts asynchronously instead of being called by orders.

intent.summary: Orders publishes order-placed on an in-process queue and billing subscribes to it.
intent.acceptance: Placing an order no longer calls billing directly; billing invoices the order after consuming order-placed.

impacts.reason: modules integrate through asynchronous events instead of direct calls
